releaseNotes: FIXED — THE SWITCHER NOW LIVES INSIDE THE CLONED APP. No more second home-screen icon, no more notification hub: every clone with the switcher shows a small draggable Ophelia ⚡ bubble while the app is open. Tap it — capture your current login, switch to a saved one, done. The switching itself was rebuilt (all file work off the UI thread + a hard restart after each switch) so the crashes on the old Switch button are gone for good.

NEW — EDIT INSTALLED CLONES: the Edit button on every clone card lets you change the clone's NAME and ICON any time. It installs as an in-place update, so data, logins, chats and saved switcher accounts are all preserved.
FIXED — UNINSTALL BUTTON: the delete button on a clone card now reliably opens the Android uninstall confirmation (the old version silently did nothing).

FIXED — DEADLOCK STUDIO CREDIT PLACEMENT: the credit is never printed inside an app's own logo anymore (your Discord logo stays clean). It lives where it belongs: in the big teal→rose gradient box pinned to the very bottom of the home screen and the switcher panel.
Switching auto-saves the login you are leaving, so you can hop back and forth without re-capturing. Old clones: tap ↻ (update) on their card to rebuild them with the new in-app switcher.
